articles.title: Expanding connectivity in the Americas Introducing Alisios Canoa and OlaLuz subsea cables
articles.summary: Google announces three new subsea cable systems to expand its global network infrastructure in the Americas.
articles.detail: The new cables will improve connectivity and resilience across the region, supporting everything from daily internet use to telehealth and scientific research breakthroughs.

articles.title: ClusterNetworkPolicy in GKE Balancing control and autonomy for your microservices
articles.summary: Google introduces ClusterNetworkPolicy in GKE to balance network security with developer needs.
articles.detail: The new policy provides a flexible way to manage network security while giving developers the autonomy they need to innovate.

articles.title: Google named a Leader in The Forrester Wave AI Platforms Q3 2026
articles.summary: Google is recognized as a leader in the Forrester Wave for AI platforms, Q3 2026.
articles.detail: The recognition highlights Google's commitment to providing a unified platform for building and operationalizing complex AI workflows.

articles.title: AWS Weekly Roundup AWS Heroes Summit Web Search on Amazon Bedrock Dogwood Kiro Crew and more August 10 2026
articles.summary: AWS announces its Heroes Summit, a gathering of experts in AI, serverless, and containers.
articles.detail: The event brings together global experts to collaborate and celebrate the builders who go above and beyond for the AWS community.

articles.title: Building real-time applications with WebSocket using Amazon VPC Lattice
articles.summary: AWS introduces a new architecture pattern for implementing WebSocket connectivity through VPC Lattice services.
articles.detail: The pattern provides a flexible way to manage network security and traffic flows for real-time applications.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Local AI Community Fuel Open Source Models and Intelligent Agents
articles.summary: NVIDIA celebrates the open source ecosystem's progress in local AI, including models, applications, and tools.
articles.detail: The company highlights its own contributions to the ecosystem, including open models and software.

articles.summary: NVIDIA partners with major financial institutions to establish financing platforms for AI compute infrastructure.
articles.detail: The partnerships aim to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital to fuel the growth of AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Vulnerability Summary for the Week of August 3 2026
articles.summary: CISA publishes a vulnerability summary for the week of August 3, 2026.
articles.detail: The summary highlights high-vulnerability issues in various products and services.

articles.title: A Snapdragon-powered Pixel might sound amazing Here’s why it’s a terrible idea
articles.summary: An article argues that Google switching to Snapdragon chips for its Pixel phones is not the best idea.
articles.detail: The author cites various reasons, including potential conflicts with Tensor chips and the need for customized hardware.

articles.title: 48% of Google Cloud Revenue Next Year Could Come From Just 2 Companies That Have Still Never Turned a Profit
articles.summary: An article suggests that two companies could account for nearly half of Google Cloud's revenue next year.
articles.detail: The author analyzes the revenue growth powering Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure.

articles.title: The Illusion of Enterprise AI Governance Why Tech Giants Are Selling a Black-Box Fantasy—And the Only Real Solution
articles.summary: An article argues that tech giants are selling an illusion of enterprise AI governance.
articles.detail: The author suggests that true accountability can only be achieved through transparency and open systems.

articles.title: Nvidia invests up to US$3B in Lancium as energy becomes new AI bottleneck

articles.title: Anthropic Locks In $10B European Compute Bet With a Seven-Month-Old Startup
articles.summary: Anthropic establishes its first dedicated European AI compute footprint with a seven-month-old startup.
articles.detail: The deal marks a significant geographic expansion in the race for sovereign-grade processing power.

articles.title: You can’t regulate your way to AI sovereignty
articles.summary: An article argues that regulating AI is not enough to achieve sovereignty.
articles.detail: The author suggests that building a sovereign AI ecosystem requires more than just laws and regulations.

articles.title: Arm Stock Is Off 39% From Its High Why This Could Be the Best Time to Buy
articles.summary: An article suggests that Arm Holdings' stock is undervalued and could be a good buy.
articles.detail: The author cites the company's benefits from accelerating AI adoption and growing demand for its chip architecture.
